headline: Goldman Sachs (GS) Launches Private Markets Platform And Buys AEGIS Hedging Solutions
summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) has launched a new private markets platform aimed at wealthy clients, expanding access to alternative investments. Goldman Sachs Alternatives has agreed to acquire AEGIS Hedging Solutions, a provider of risk management and hedging services. For investors watching how Goldman Sachs Group positions itself beyond traditional investment banking, these two moves sit squarely in its asset and wealth management efforts. headline: Why Economist Mohamed El-Erian Monitors South Korea, U.K. Bonds, and the Yen
summary: El-Erian warned that rising borrowing costs and a decline in reliable buyers of U.S. debt are straining bond markets.
